description: Held-out query evaluation set (30 questions). Gold answers come from the hand-written gold_sql, which queries the observation table directly and shares no code with the Query Agent's tools. 'demo' marks the 10 queries run live in the Phase 3 demonstration (>=2 spatial, >=2 temporal, >=1 provenance).

check_rules.top1: agent's first row has the gold top location and a value within 0.5%
check_rules.series: agent returns exactly the gold periods and every value lies in the gold [min,max] (+-0.5%)
check_rules.peak: agent's peak period equals the gold maximum period
check_rules.provenance: agent's first citation (document, page) is one of the gold rows and its value matches
check_rules.value: agent's first value lies in the gold [min,max] (+-0.5%)
check_rules.agree: agent's count of periods reported by 2+ documents equals the gold count

queries.question: Which agri zone produced the most paddy in 2025-26?
queries.gold_sql: SELECT o.location_id, MAX(o.value) AS value FROM observation o JOIN location l ON l.location_id=o.location_id WHERE o.metric_id='production' AND o.commodity_id='paddy' AND l.level='agri_zone' AND o.period_label='2025-26' AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.item') IS NULL AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.variety') IS NULL AND o.value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.location_id ORDER BY value DESC

queries.question: Which islands within 60 km of Port Blair have the most farmers?
queries.gold_sql: SELECT i.location_id, MAX(o.value) AS value FROM location r, location i JOIN observation o ON o.location_id=i.location_id WHERE r.location_id='TH_PORTBLAIR' AND i.level='island' AND o.metric_id='farmers_count' AND o.period_label='2024-25' AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.item') IS NULL AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.variety') IS NULL AND o.value IS NOT NULL AND 6371*2*asin(sqrt(power(sin(radians(i.lat-r.lat)/2),2)+cos(radians(r.lat))*cos(radians(i.lat))*power(sin(radians(i.lon-r.lon)/2),2))) <= 60 GROUP BY i.location_id ORDER BY value DESC

queries.question: How did paddy production in the UT change from 2019-20 to 2025-26?
